raw_text: The MuddyWater campaign against Indian infrastructure is significant because it marks Iranian APT expansion into South Asian critical infrastructure targeting. Using compromised .gov.in domains for delivery is clever social engineering since recipients trust government sources. The Atera agent is a legitimate RMM tool being abused which makes detection harder. This is a wake-up call for Indian critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
